text: 据《日经新闻》报道，日本金融厅将审查日本金融机构是否充分评估了向海外非银行贷款机构和房地产公司放贷相关的信用风险。这一想法将被纳入该机构正在制定的年度战略重点计划草案中，该计划将于明年6月最终定稿。日本大型银行的海外非银行贷款业务正在扩大，所谓非银行金融中介机构正在全球范围内扩张，并越来越多地从日本银行获得融资。在房地产领域，主要大都市地区的房价持续飙升，促使地区银行和其他金融机构增加相关贷款。金融厅认为，有必要进一步审视这些信用风险。此外，金融厅还将重点审查数据中心等设施的投资和贷款政策、项目审查以及风险管理。
text_en: According to the Nikkei, Japan's Financial Services Agency will review whether Japanese financial institutions are adequately assessing credit risks related to lending to overseas non-bank lenders and real estate companies. This idea will be incorporated into the draft of the agency's annual strategic priority plan, which is set to be finalized in June next year. Overseas non-bank lending operations of major Japanese banks are expanding, with so-called non-bank financial intermediaries growing globally and increasingly obtaining financing from Japanese banks. In the real estate sector, housing prices in major metropolitan areas continue to surge, prompting regional banks and other financial institutions to increase related lending. The FSA believes there is a need to further scrutinize these credit risks. Additionally, the FSA will focus on reviewing investment and lending policies, project screening, and risk management for facilities such as data centers.
